note: The Seychelles case study covers national e-government only: DICT's strategic plan lists better intra-government connection as a policy action, each ministry or agency houses its own data with no government-wide hosting, and the national portals (SeyID, SeyGo Connect, E-Services Gateway) are described. It names no district administration or other local government office, no government network by name and no connection to any office; its mentions of local government concern South Africa and general recommendations.
